audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers give Vladimir Levels 2 and 3, but whys[1] calls Level 2 'your single biggest window' and whys[2] says 'own this stage hard'. Level 6 was marked Skill in both layers while whys[4], spikes[2] and mid all say Sanguine Pool flips the lane at 6.
audit.why: Vladimir has no Sanguine Pool until 4 and no answer to a Level 2 Q + Lightslinger double-shot; at 6 the pool's 2 seconds of untargetability blanks Lucian's whole commit on a 28s-at-rank-1 cooldown.
audit.corrected: Levels 2 and 3 flipped to Lucian, Level 6 flipped to Vladimir, in both layers with matching ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why still describes The Culling as the Level 6 spike, on a row where Vladimir's pool is the actual power shift.
audit.why: Vladimir's R is a flat 120s, but W is the ability that decides the level-6 stage — it dodges the Culling channel outright.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why rewritten around Sanguine Pool's untargetability and its cooldown.
sources: brief enemyKit W and R text

audit.why: The untargetability interaction is already stated correctly in whys[4], spikes[2], mid and wants.foe[1] — pool eats the W mark, the dash damage and the Culling channel. Nothing to correct.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal appears only as a trailing clause in the itemization report line; no Do or Don't tells you when to buy it, and nothing states that Transfusion costs zero mana.
audit.why: Transfusion is a free heal on a 4.6s cooldown at rank 5, so Grievous Wounds timing — not damage — is what decides every extended trade after Levels 4-5.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2] repurposed to the anti-heal buy and the mana-free heal that makes it necessary.

edits.before: E online — dash-weave trades start now: spell, double-shot, dash out before his answer lands.
edits.after: E online and he has no pool until 4 — spell, double-shot, dash out before Transfusion heals it.

edits.before: Full kit: Q-AA-E-AA-W-AA strings chunk a third of his HP. Trade on every CS he takes from the wrong angle.
edits.after: Full kit: Q-AA-E-AA-W-AA strings chunk a third of his HP, and he still has no untargetable button to answer them.

edits.before: The Culling adds lane-clear and execute chip — use it through walls on recalls and low-HP escapes.
edits.after: Sanguine Pool goes untargetable for 2s and blanks The Culling — bait it out; it's 28s at rank 1.

edits.before: Pick the four-second windows and out-burst the poke war. Sanguine Pool is the clock this lane runs on — read it before every step forward.
edits.after: Pick the four-second windows and out-burst the poke war. Sanguine Pool is a 28s clock at rank 1 — bait it out, then spend everything.

edits.before: Vladimir burns Sanguine Pool on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Transfusion costs no mana and heals off every minion — Grievous Wounds is the gate.

notes: Sanguine Pool's untargetability is confirmed in Riot's text; whether it also removes damage already in flight from The Culling's individual shots is not in the kit data, so I said only that it blanks the channel. Anti-heal item name (Executioner's Calling) left out of the edited string to keep it inside the length band — the itemization report line already names anti-heal generically.
